title: How Urban Interventions in Lower Socioeconomic Areas Influence Health Behaviors (UrbASanté Study)
summary: The UrbASanté study is a quasi-experimental research that aimed at assessing the impact of urban transformations (a natural experiment) in the health related behaviors, environmental exposure and perceived- health.
criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Living in areas with urban intervention in Porte de la Chapelle, Paris (for experimental group)
* Living in areas without direct urban interventions close to Porte de la Chapelle, Paris (for control group)
* Age above 18 years
